notes.title: Patch Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
In patch 1.1.1 we have updated the following :



Updated art assets for all game menus

Fonts updated for all menus

New "Main Menu" Music 

New Foley/SFX audio implemented

New death animation (Aya disappears)

Quality of life improvements
